ModMetaData.name: Fambaa Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces mlie.starwarsanimalcollection's Fambaa art (adult south/east/north facings only - the juvenile stage, the swimming graphic and the dessicated-corpse texture stay on donor art) with custom generated art per the 2026-09-10 sitting ruling: TOTAL art redo for this SW canon creature, gathered from inspirational reference, never a rename. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (swanimals/Fambaa/Fambaa_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
UNVERIFIED as of authoring: the donor ships these textures inside a Unity AssetBundle (AssetBundles/, no loose Textures/swanimals/ folder at all), not as loose files. Loose-overrides-loose-by-load-order is proven elsewhere in this repo; loose-overrides-AssetBundle-by-load-order is NOT yet confirmed working for this donor - same open question as MynockArtOverride. Needs a live look (spawn/view a Fambaa in-game) before this mod is trusted.
